title: 米約高架橋
summary: 米約高架橋以七座混凝土高墩、七座鋼塔與 2,460 公尺連續鋼箱梁跨越法國塔恩河谷，最高墩約 245 公尺、塔頂高 343 公尺。本課從河谷高空風與多跨斜張體系的勁度問題出發，分析雙肢橋墩、正交異性鋼箱梁與 154 根單股斜索，再拆解由兩岸頂推、經臨時鋼墩把跨徑減半的施工法與合龍，最後談斜索監測、載重試驗、鋼橋面疲勞與特許經營期的維護。
summaryEn: The Millau Viaduct crosses the Tarn valley in France on seven concrete piers, seven steel pylons and a 2,460 m continuous steel box deck, with the tallest pier about 245 m and the pylon tops at 343 m. The course starts with high-level valley wind and the stiffness problem of multi-span cable-stayed bridges, examines split-shaft piers, the orthotropic steel box and 154 monostrand stays, then unpacks launching from both abutments over temporary towers that halve the spans and the closure, ending with stay monitoring, load testing, deck fatigue and maintenance through the concession.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 頂推設計練習：鋼梁自重 w = 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m，即約 143.6 kN/m。頂推到臨時墩前，若無鼻樑，171 m 懸臂根部彎矩 M₀ = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m。改用 40 m、30 kN/m 的鋼鼻樑時，鋼梁懸臂只剩 131 m：M = 143.6×131²/2 + 30×40×(131 + 20) ≈ 1.232×10⁶ + 0.181×10⁶ ≈ 1.41×10⁶ kN·m，減少約 33%。南段 1,743 m 鋼梁重約 1,743×143.6 ≈ 250,000 kN；若滑動摩擦 μ = 0.03、縱坡 i = 3.025%，向上坡推需 F ≈ W·(μ + i) ≈ 15,100 kN，向下坡則 W·(μ − i) ≈ 0，表示梁會自行下滑，必須設置制動與反推。由此可見輕量鼻樑與頂推斜索比推力大小更關鍵，控制量是懸臂根部彎矩與下坡時的制動。鼻樑長度、重量與摩擦係數為教學假設，不代表米約的實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Launching exercise: the steel deck weighs w = 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m, about 143.6 kN/m. Before reaching a temporary tower, a 171 m cantilever without a nose has a root moment M₀ = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m. With a 40 m nose weighing 30 kN/m, only 131 m of deck cantilevers: M = 143.6×131²/2 + 30×40×(131 + 20) ≈ 1.232×10⁶ + 0.181×10⁶ ≈ 1.41×10⁶ kN·m, about 33% less. The 1,743 m south section weighs about 1,743×143.6 ≈ 250,000 kN; with sliding friction μ = 0.03 and gradient i = 3.025%, pushing uphill needs F ≈ W·(μ + i) ≈ 15,100 kN, while downhill W·(μ − i) ≈ 0, meaning the deck would run away by itself and needs braking and restraint. The comparison shows why a light nose and launching stays matter more than raw pushing capacity: the critical quantities are the root moment and the restraint of a deck that wants to slide downhill. Nose length, weight and friction are teaching assumptions, not Millau's actual design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」與「多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Valley wind and traffic safety" and "Multi-span stays and pier stiffness": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Valley wind and traffic safety: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋面風屏」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck wind screens” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 米約高架橋的橋面距塔恩河最高約 270 公尺，河谷地形使強風加速並伴隨陣風，風荷載同時作用在鋼箱梁、橋墩、鋼塔與 154 根斜索上。對結構而言，橫向風力經箱梁傳到支承與墩頂，再由高墩以彎矩傳到基礎；對使用者而言，側風會讓高車身車輛偏移或傾覆，因此橋面兩側設置風屏，以降低車道上的風速。風屏本身卻增加了箱梁的受風面積與阻力，必須在風洞試驗中同時評估行車舒適與結構風載的取捨。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面風屏」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Millau deck stands up to about 270 m above the Tarn, and the valley topography accelerates strong winds and gusts that act at once on the steel box girder, piers, pylons and 154 stays. Structurally, lateral wind on the deck passes through bearings to the pier heads and then down the tall piers as bending to the foundations; for users, crosswinds push or overturn high-sided vehicles, so wind screens line both deck edges to cut wind speed over the lanes. The screens add exposed area and drag to the girder, so wind-tunnel testing must weigh traffic comfort against structural wind load. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck wind screens” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風壓 q = ½ρV²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind pressure q = ½ρV².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋面風屏」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck wind screens”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Valley wind and traffic safety: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面風屏」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck wind screens” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風壓 q = ½ρV²。取 V = 50 m/s、ρ = 1.225 kg/m³，q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa。箱梁深 4.2 m 加上風屏等效高度共 7.2 m、阻力係數 C_D = 1.3，每公尺橫向力 = 1,531×1.3×7.2 ≈ 14.3 kN/m；一個 342 m 跨約 4,900 kN。風速、等效高度與 C_D 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind pressure q = ½ρV². With V = 50 m/s and ρ = 1.225 kg/m³, q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa. Taking the 4.2 m box plus screens as an equivalent 7.2 m height with C_D = 1.3, the lateral force is 1,531×1.3×7.2 ≈ 14.3 kN/m, about 4,900 kN on one 342 m span. Wind speed, equivalent height and C_D are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以斷面模型風洞試驗量測有無風屏時的阻力、升力與力矩係數，並以全橋氣動彈性模型或分析確認抖振反應；營運期以橋面風速計記錄實際風速與陣風因子，與設計風況比較，並作為交通限制的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients with and without screens in sectional wind-tunnel tests, and confirm buffeting response with a full aeroelastic model or analysis; in service, deck anemometers record actual mean speeds and gust factors for comparison with design winds and as the basis for traffic restrictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Valley wind and traffic safety", which statement holds?

steps.title: 塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Valley wind and traffic safety: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面風屏」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck wind screens” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以斷面模型風洞試驗量測有無風屏時的阻力、升力與力矩係數，並以全橋氣動彈性模型或分析確認抖振反應；營運期以橋面風速計記錄實際風速與陣風因子，與設計風況比較，並作為交通限制的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients with and without screens in sectional wind-tunnel tests, and confirm buffeting response with a full aeroelastic model or analysis; in service, deck anemometers record actual mean speeds and gust factors for comparison with design winds and as the basis for traffic restrictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風屏的孔隙率、高度與固定方式應與結構設計同一批風洞試驗決定，更換或改型須經結構工程師重新檢核；交通管理單位應依橋面實測風速建立分級限制程序並定期檢討。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Screen porosity, height and fixing should be fixed in the same wind-tunnel campaign as the structure, and any replacement or redesign re-checked by the structural engineer; the operator should base staged traffic restrictions on measured deck wind speeds and review them periodically.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以風屏改善行車條件而未把風屏阻力納入結構設計，強風下橋墩彎矩與支承橫向力會超出預期；反之若風屏孔隙設計不當，車道風速降不下來，強風時只能封橋，交通可靠度大打折扣。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding screens for traffic without including their drag in structural design lets pier moments and lateral bearing forces exceed predictions in storms; conversely, poorly designed screen porosity fails to reduce lane wind speeds, forcing closures in strong winds and undermining reliability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 風屏的孔隙率、高度與固定方式應與結構設計同一批風洞試驗決定，更換或改型須經結構工程師重新檢核；交通管理單位應依橋面實測風速建立分級限制程序並定期檢討。

quiz.question: 要驗證「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Valley wind and traffic safety"?
options: 以斷面模型風洞試驗量測有無風屏時的阻力、升力與力矩係數，並以全橋氣動彈性模型或分析確認抖振反應。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients with and without screens in sectional wind-tunnel tests, and confirm buffeting response with a full aeroelastic model or analysis.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.instruction: 若只以風屏改善行車條件而未把風屏阻力納入結構設計，強風下橋墩彎矩與支承橫向力會超出預期；反之若風屏孔隙設計不當，車道風速降不下來，強風時只能封橋，交通可靠度大打折扣。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Multi-span stays and pier stiffness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙肢橋墩上段」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Split upper pier shafts” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一般斜張橋靠錨碇跨把背索固定在地面，塔頂水平位移受控；米約有六個 342 公尺主跨連續排列，中間各塔沒有錨碇跨，活載只放在某一跨時，塔頂會被拉向受載跨，箱梁與橋墩必須提供勁度抵抗這種不對稱變形。另一方面，長 2,460 公尺的連續鋼梁隨溫度伸縮，墩頂被強迫水平位移，若橋墩太剛就會產生很大的彎矩。設計者的解法是讓每座墩在上部約 90 公尺分成兩肢：兩肢組成的框架對不對稱活載提供彎曲勁度，單肢較細又能柔和地跟隨梁體伸縮。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙肢橋墩上段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A conventional cable-stayed bridge ties its back stays to the ground through anchor spans, limiting tower-top sway; Millau has six 342 m main spans in a row, so the inner pylons have no anchor spans, and live load on one span pulls the pylon tops toward it, requiring the deck and piers to resist this unbalanced deformation. At the same time the 2,460 m continuous steel deck expands and contracts with temperature, forcing horizontal displacement at the pier heads, which would create large moments in a very stiff pier. The designers split the upper part of each pier, about 90 m, into two shafts: acting as a frame they give bending stiffness against unbalanced live load, while each slender shaft follows the deck's thermal movement more gently. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Split upper pier shafts” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設梁體以中央 P4 附近為不動點，P1 與 P4 之間為三個主跨，距不動點 3×342 = 1,026 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume the deck is fixed near the central pier P4, so P1, three main spans away, lies 3×342 = 1,026 m from it.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙肢橋墩上段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multi-span stays and pier stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙肢橋墩上段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Split upper pier shafts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設梁體以中央 P4 附近為不動點，P1 與 P4 之間為三個主跨，距不動點 3×342 = 1,026 m。鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、溫差 35 °C：墩頂強迫位移 Δ = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,026×35 ≈ 0.431 m。若把實心墩頭剖成兩片各為一半深度的薄肢，單肢慣性矩為原來的 1/8，兩肢獨立彎曲時合計約 1/4。不動點與溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume the deck is fixed near the central pier P4, so P1, three main spans away, lies 3×342 = 1,026 m from it. With steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C and a 35 °C range, the imposed pier-head movement is Δ = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,026×35 ≈ 0.431 m. Splitting a solid head into two leaves of half depth gives each leaf 1/8 of the original second moment, about 1/4 for both bending independently. Fixed point and temperature range are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以考慮幾何非線性的全橋模型，分別計算單跨滿載、隔跨滿載與溫度工況下的塔頂位移、墩底彎矩與箱梁應力；施工中以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測墩頂位移與溫度的關係，與模型預測比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a geometrically nonlinear whole-bridge model to compute pylon-top sway, pier-base moments and deck stresses for one span loaded, alternate spans loaded and temperature cases; during construction measure pier-head movement against temperature with GNSS and inclinometers and compare with predictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以考慮幾何非線性的全橋模型，分別計算單跨滿載、隔跨滿載與溫度工況下的塔頂位移、墩底彎矩與箱梁應力；施工中以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測墩頂位移與溫度的關係，與模型預測比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis for a multi-span cable-stayed bridge should list unbalanced live-load patterns with temperature combinations and treat the pier–pylon–deck stiffness ratio as a parameter in sensitivity studies; the monitoring plan should define pier-head movement alert values and the temperature conditions for measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若橋墩只為溫度變形設計得很柔，不對稱活載下塔頂位移過大、箱梁撓度與彎矩超出容許；若為了勁度做得太剛，溫度伸縮會在墩底產生巨大彎矩與裂縫，兩者都無法單靠加大斷面解決。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

Use a geometrically nonlinear whole-bridge model to compute pylon-top sway, pier-base moments and deck stresses for one span loaded, alternate spans loaded and temperature cases.
Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-span stays and pier stiffness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙肢橋墩上段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Split upper pier shafts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若橋墩只為溫度變形設計得很柔，不對稱活載下塔頂位移過大、箱梁撓度與彎矩超出容許；若為了勁度做得太剛，溫度伸縮會在墩底產生巨大彎矩與裂縫，兩者都無法單靠加大斷面解決。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Piers made very flexible for thermal movement let pylon tops sway excessively under unbalanced live load, overstressing and over-deflecting the deck; piers made very stiff for live load develop huge base moments and cracks from thermal movement, and neither problem is solved simply by enlarging sections. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計者的解法是讓每座墩在上部約 90 公尺分成兩肢：兩肢組成的框架對不對稱活載提供彎曲勁度，單肢較細又能柔和地跟隨梁體伸縮。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The designers split the upper part of each pier, about 90 m, into two shafts: acting as a frame they give bending stiffness against unbalanced live load, while each slender shaft follows the deck's thermal movement more gently.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「正交異性鋼箱梁與高強度鋼」與「154 根斜索與錨碇設計」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Orthotropic steel box and high-strength steel" and "The 154 stays and their anchorages": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 正交異性鋼箱梁與高強度鋼：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Orthotropic steel box and high-strength steel: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「中央箱梁高強度鋼板」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-strength central box plate” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 米約的橋面是梯形斷面的正交異性鋼箱梁，深 4.20 公尺、寬約 32 公尺，由中央箱與兩側面板組成，總重約 36,000 公噸。頂板以縱向加勁肋與橫隔板支撐，同時作為行車面、箱梁上翼板與斜索錨碇區的傳力板。鋼材供應商資料顯示，接近一半的鋼材採用 460 MPa 等級的 DI-MC 460，用於中央箱、面板、鋼塔與塔腳，其餘為 S355；在受力大的位置用高強度鋼可以減少板厚與自重，對頂推與斜索都有利，但焊接程序與韌性要求更嚴格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「中央箱梁高強度鋼板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Millau's deck is a trapezoidal orthotropic steel box 4.20 m deep and about 32 m wide, made of a central box and side panels, weighing about 36,000 t. The top plate, stiffened by longitudinal ribs and cross-diaphragms, is at once the running surface, the box's top flange and the load-spreading plate at stay anchorages. The steel supplier reports that almost half of the steel was DI-MC 460, a 460 MPa grade, used in the central box, panels, pylons and pylon feet, with S355 elsewhere; high-strength plate where forces are large cuts thickness and self-weight, helping both launching and the stays, but demands stricter welding procedures and toughness. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “High-strength central box plate” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The deck averages about 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部改用高強度鋼一定最省錢、最安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Using high-strength steel everywhere is always the cheapest and safest choice." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「中央箱梁高強度鋼板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “High-strength central box plate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「正交異性鋼箱梁與高強度鋼」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Orthotropic steel box and high-strength steel" is correct?

steps.title: 正交異性鋼箱梁與高強度鋼：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Orthotropic steel box and high-strength steel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中央箱梁高強度鋼板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-strength central box plate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：全橋鋼梁約 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m。若某段下翼板需傳遞 60 MN 壓力：S355 需 A = 60×10⁶/355×10⁶ ≈ 0.169 m²（約 1,327 kg/m），S460 需 0.130 m²（約 1,024 kg/m），節省約 23%。60 MN 為教學假設，未計穩定折減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The deck averages about 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m. If a bottom flange must carry 60 MN of compression, S355 needs A = 60×10⁶/355×10⁶ ≈ 0.169 m² (about 1,327 kg/m) while S460 needs 0.130 m² (about 1,024 kg/m), a saving of about 23%. The 60 MN is a teaching assumption, ignoring stability reductions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋼板到廠時核對材質證明的強度、衝擊韌性與化學成分，焊接前做焊接程序評定（含熱影響區韌性）；板件製作後以超音波或相位陣列檢查全滲透焊道，並以尺寸量測確認面板、加勁肋與橫隔板的幾何允差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On delivery check mill certificates for strength, impact toughness and chemistry, qualify welding procedures including heat-affected-zone toughness, and after fabrication inspect full-penetration welds by ultrasonic or phased-array testing while measuring panels, ribs and diaphragms against dimensional tolerances.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「正交異性鋼箱梁與高強度鋼」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 正交異性鋼箱梁與高強度鋼：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Orthotropic steel box and high-strength steel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「中央箱梁高強度鋼板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High-strength central box plate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋼板到廠時核對材質證明的強度、衝擊韌性與化學成分，焊接前做焊接程序評定（含熱影響區韌性）；板件製作後以超音波或相位陣列檢查全滲透焊道，並以尺寸量測確認面板、加勁肋與橫隔板的幾何允差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On delivery check mill certificates for strength, impact toughness and chemistry, qualify welding procedures including heat-affected-zone toughness, and after fabrication inspect full-penetration welds by ultrasonic or phased-array testing while measuring panels, ribs and diaphragms against dimensional tolerances. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：材料規格應依部位指定鋼級與韌性等級，並把焊接程序評定、預熱控制與無損檢測比例寫入製造規範；高強度鋼的修補焊須經焊接工程師核准，不得現場臨時決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The material specification should assign steel grade and toughness class by location and write procedure qualification, preheat control and inspection rates into the fabrication specification; repair welding of high-strength steel must be approved by the welding engineer, never improvised on site.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高強度鋼若沿用一般鋼的焊接預熱與入熱，熱影響區可能變脆或產生氫致裂紋；面板與加勁肋尺寸偏差過大時，頂推經過墩頂的局部集中力會使腹板或底板屈曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding high-strength plate with ordinary-steel preheat and heat input can embrittle the heat-affected zone or cause hydrogen cracking; panels and ribs outside tolerance can buckle webs or bottom plates under the concentrated forces as the deck passes over each support during launching. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鋼板到廠時核對材質證明的強度、衝擊韌性與化學成分，焊接前做焊接程序評定（含熱影響區韌性）；板件製作後以超音波或相位陣列檢查全滲透焊道，並以尺寸量測確認面板、加勁肋與橫隔板的幾何允差。
knowledge.textEn: On delivery check mill certificates for strength, impact toughness and chemistry, qualify welding procedures including heat-affected-zone toughness, and after fabrication inspect full-penetration welds by ultrasonic or phased-array testing while measuring panels, ribs and diaphragms against dimensional tolerances.

knowledge.text: 材料規格應依部位指定鋼級與韌性等級，並把焊接程序評定、預熱控制與無損檢測比例寫入製造規範；高強度鋼的修補焊須經焊接工程師核准，不得現場臨時決定。

steps.title: 正交異性鋼箱梁與高強度鋼：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Orthotropic steel box and high-strength steel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中央箱梁高強度鋼板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High-strength central box plate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高強度鋼若沿用一般鋼的焊接預熱與入熱，熱影響區可能變脆或產生氫致裂紋；面板與加勁肋尺寸偏差過大時，頂推經過墩頂的局部集中力會使腹板或底板屈曲。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Welding high-strength plate with ordinary-steel preheat and heat input can embrittle the heat-affected zone or cause hydrogen cracking; panels and ribs outside tolerance can buckle webs or bottom plates under the concentrated forces as the deck passes over each support during launching. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼材供應商資料顯示，接近一半的鋼材採用 460 MPa 等級的 DI-MC 460，用於中央箱、面板、鋼塔與塔腳，其餘為 S355；在受力大的位置用高強度鋼可以減少板厚與自重，對頂推與斜索都有利，但焊接程序與韌性要求更嚴格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The steel supplier reports that almost half of the steel was DI-MC 460, a 460 MPa grade, used in the central box, panels, pylons and pylon feet, with S355 elsewhere; high-strength plate where forces are large cuts thickness and self-weight, helping both launching and the stays, but demands stricter welding procedures and toughness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部改用高強度鋼一定最省錢、最安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Using high-strength steel everywhere is always the cheapest and safest choice." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 154 根斜索與錨碇設計：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The 154 stays and their anchorages: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「單股鋼絞線斜索」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Monostrand stay cables” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 七座鋼塔各以單一索面、半扇形配置 22 根斜索，全橋共 154 根，每根由 55 至 91 股直徑 15.7 mm 的鋼絞線組成，鋼絞線熱浸鍍鋅、塗蠟並各自包覆高密度聚乙烯，鋼絞線抗拉強度 1,860 MPa，斜索鋼材合計約 1,500 公噸。單股可個別張拉、檢查與更換，是長期維護的關鍵。公開技術文章指出，米約斜索在使用荷載下工作在保證破斷強度的 50%，高於一般常用的 45%，因此錨具的疲勞與彎曲應力限制特別嚴格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「單股鋼絞線斜索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each of the seven steel pylons carries 22 stays in a single central plane and semi-fan layout, 154 in all, each made of 55 to 91 strands of 15.7 mm diameter that are hot-dip galvanised, waxed and individually sheathed in high-density polyethylene, with 1,860 MPa strength and about 1,500 t of stay steel in total. Strands can be stressed, inspected and replaced one by one, which is central to long-term maintenance. A published technical paper states that the stays work at 50% of guaranteed breaking strength under service loads, above the usual 45%, so fatigue and bending-stress limits at the anchorages are especially strict. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Monostrand stay cables” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以單股面積 150 mm² 計，91 股斜索的保證破斷力 = 91×150×1,860 ≈ 25,400 kN；50% 時使用索力約 12,700 kN，45% 時約 11,400 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking 150 mm² per strand, a 91-strand stay has a guaranteed breaking load of 91×150×1,860 ≈ 25,400 kN, so 50% gives about 12,700 kN in service versus about 11,400 kN at 45%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索容許應力越高越好，只要強度夠就不必考慮疲勞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the allowable stay stress the better; fatigue need not be checked if strength is sufficient." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「單股鋼絞線斜索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Monostrand stay cables”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 154 根斜索與錨碇設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The 154 stays and their anchorages: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單股鋼絞線斜索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Monostrand stay cables” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以單股面積 150 mm² 計，91 股斜索的保證破斷力 = 91×150×1,860 ≈ 25,400 kN；50% 時使用索力約 12,700 kN，45% 時約 11,400 kN。55 股的破斷力 55×150×1,860 ≈ 15,345 kN，其 99% 約 15,190 kN，與公開的 15,220 kN 試驗力同量級。單股面積為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking 150 mm² per strand, a 91-strand stay has a guaranteed breaking load of 91×150×1,860 ≈ 25,400 kN, so 50% gives about 12,700 kN in service versus about 11,400 kN at 45%. A 55-strand stay breaks at 55×150×1,860 ≈ 15,345 kN, and 99% of that, about 15,190 kN, matches the published 15,220 kN test load in magnitude. Strand area is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以原型斜索做疲勞試驗（公開資料：55 股索以 200 MPa 應力幅、200 萬次循環）後再拉到接近破斷，確認錨具效率；現場以等張力法逐股張拉並以測力計或頻率法驗證每根索力，記錄溫度與施工階段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fatigue-test prototype stays (published: a 55-strand stay at a 200 MPa stress range for 2 million cycles) and then pull them close to failure to confirm anchorage efficiency; on site stress strand by strand to equal force and verify each stay with load cells or frequency methods, recording temperature and construction stage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 154 根斜索與錨碇設計：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The 154 stays and their anchorages: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「單股鋼絞線斜索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Monostrand stay cables” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以原型斜索做疲勞試驗（公開資料：55 股索以 200 MPa 應力幅、200 萬次循環）後再拉到接近破斷，確認錨具效率；現場以等張力法逐股張拉並以測力計或頻率法驗證每根索力，記錄溫度與施工階段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue-test prototype stays (published: a 55-strand stay at a 200 MPa stress range for 2 million cycles) and then pull them close to failure to confirm anchorage efficiency; on site stress strand by strand to equal force and verify each stay with load cells or frequency methods, recording temperature and construction stage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 雙向頂推與臨時墩：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Launching from both sides over temporary towers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「頂推器與臨時鋼墩」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Launching units and temporary towers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼箱梁在兩岸平台上組裝，由南岸頂推約 1,743 公尺、北岸約 717 公尺。342 公尺的主跨在頂推階段過長，因此在每跨中央設置可伸縮的臨時鋼墩，把懸臂長度減為約 171 公尺，最高的臨時墩約 170–180 公尺；橫跨塔恩河的 P2–P3 跨沒有臨時墩，改以先裝在 P2、P3 上的鋼塔與預先安裝的永久斜索承托懸臂。每座墩頂的頂推器先把梁頂起再向前推，公開報導稱每個循環推進 600 mm、約 4 分鐘，全程共 18 次頂推作業，由中央控制室同步各墩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「頂推器與臨時鋼墩」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The steel deck was assembled on platforms at both ends and launched about 1,743 m from the south and 717 m from the north. The 342 m spans were too long for launching, so telescopic temporary steel towers at mid-span cut the cantilever to about 171 m, the tallest roughly 170–180 m high; the P2–P3 span over the Tarn had no temporary tower and the cantilever was carried instead by pylons already fitted on P2 and P3 with permanent stays installed in advance. A launching unit on each support lifted the deck and pushed it forward; trade reports cite 600 mm per cycle in about four minutes, with 18 launch operations in all, synchronised from a central control room. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Launching units and temporary towers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鋼梁自重 w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m。無鼻樑時 171 m 懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m，是同跨簡支跨中彎矩 w·L²/8 ≈ 5.25×10⁵ kN·m 的 4 倍。每循環 600 mm、4 分鐘，推過 171 m 需 285 個循環，約 19 小時純推進時間（約 9 m/h）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Deck self-weight w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m. At 600 mm per four-minute cycle, 171 m needs 285 cycles, about 19 hours of pushing (about 9 m/h). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次頂推前確認風速預報與允許窗口，頂推中即時監測各頂推器的頂升力、推力與梁底高程，並以測量確認懸臂端到達下一支點時的下垂量與鼻樑回收；臨時墩的伸縮與垂直度在每段頂推後重新量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each launch confirm the wind forecast and permitted window; during launching monitor lift and push forces and soffit levels at every unit in real time, survey the cantilever tip sag and nose recovery as it reaches the next support, and re-measure temporary-tower extension and verticality after each launch.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.objective: 說明「河谷中央合龍段」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mid-valley closure joint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 南北兩段鋼梁在 2004 年 5 月 28 日於塔恩河上方約 268 公尺處接合，之後才把各鋼塔與其餘斜索安裝到位：公開資料指出，頂推階段先在 P3、P2 安裝 24 根頂推用斜索，其餘 130 根在 2004 年 6 月至 8 月間安裝。合龍前兩段鋼梁都是自由端，溫度變化直接改變間隙與高程差；合龍後梁成為連續體，再透過斜索張拉把恆載重新分配，並把臨時墩卸載移除。這個體系轉換的順序決定最終梁體應力與線形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「河谷中央合龍段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The north and south deck sections met on 28 May 2004 about 268 m above the Tarn, after which the remaining pylons and stays were completed: published data say 24 launching stays were first installed on P3 and P2, and the other 130 between June and August 2004. Before closure both deck ends are free, so temperature directly changes the gap and level difference; after closure the deck is continuous, stay tensioning redistributes dead load and the temporary towers are unloaded and removed. The sequence of this system change determines final deck stresses and profile. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mid-valley closure joint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：南段長 1,743 m，鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，每 1 °C 端部伸縮 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm；兩段若溫差 5 °C，間隙改變約 105 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The south section is 1,743 m long; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C its end moves 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm per °C, so a 5 °C change shifts the gap by about 105 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「河谷中央合龍段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mid-valley closure joint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：南段長 1,743 m，鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，每 1 °C 端部伸縮 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm；兩段若溫差 5 °C，間隙改變約 105 mm。因此合龍常選在夜間或清晨溫度穩定時，以臨時連接器先鎖定再焊接。溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The south section is 1,743 m long; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C its end moves 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm per °C, so a 5 °C change shifts the gap by about 105 mm. Closure is therefore made at night or dawn when temperatures are stable, locking with temporary connectors before welding. The temperature change is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：合龍前連續量測兩端間隙、高程與梁溫至少一個晝夜循環，建立間隙—溫度關係並預測合龍時段；鎖定後量測焊接前後的偏位與應變，臨時墩卸載時逐步記錄各支點反力與梁體高程，確認與施工階段分析一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before closure, record gap, levels and steel temperature for at least one day–night cycle to build a gap–temperature relation and predict the window; after locking, measure offsets and strains before and after welding, and during temporary-tower unloading log support reactions and deck levels step by step against the staged analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。
風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。
optionsEn: Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect.
The south section is 1,743 m long.
Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure.
quiz.explanation: 南段長 1,743 m，鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，每 1 °C 端部伸縮 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm；兩段若溫差 5 °C，間隙改變約 105 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The south section is 1,743 m long; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C its end moves 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm per °C, so a 5 °C change shifts the gap by about 105 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closure, pylons and stays in place: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「河谷中央合龍段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mid-valley closure joint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 合龍前連續量測兩端間隙、高程與梁溫至少一個晝夜循環，建立間隙—溫度關係並預測合龍時段；鎖定後量測焊接前後的偏位與應變，臨時墩卸載時逐步記錄各支點反力與梁體高程，確認與施工階段分析一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before closure, record gap, levels and steel temperature for at least one day–night cycle to build a gap–temperature relation and predict the window; after locking, measure offsets and strains before and after welding, and during temporary-tower unloading log support reactions and deck levels step by step against the staged analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合龍與體系轉換應有獨立的程序書：鎖定時段、焊接順序、斜索張拉與臨時墩卸載的步驟與每步允許偏差；每一步完成後由監控小組比對量測與預測，偏差超過預警即暫停，由設計單位決定修正方案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Closure and system change need a dedicated procedure: locking window, welding sequence, stay tensioning and temporary-tower unloading steps with tolerances; after each step the monitoring team compares measurements with predictions and stops at alert deviations, leaving the correction to the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在溫度快速變化時強行焊接合龍，焊道冷卻中受拉而開裂或產生鎖入應力；臨時墩卸載順序錯誤則讓相鄰斜索或支承瞬間超載，梁體出現不預期的扭轉或局部屈曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Forcing a closure weld while temperatures change quickly can crack the cooling weld or lock in stresses; unloading temporary towers in the wrong order can momentarily overload neighbouring stays or bearings, causing unexpected twist or local buckling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closure, pylons and stays in place"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
全部改用高強度鋼一定最省錢、最安全。

Using high-strength steel everywhere is always the cheapest and safest choice.
Before closure, record gap, levels and steel temperature for at least one day–night cycle to build a gap–temperature relation and predict the window.
quiz.explanation: 合龍前連續量測兩端間隙、高程與梁溫至少一個晝夜循環，建立間隙—溫度關係並預測合龍時段；鎖定後量測焊接前後的偏位與應變，臨時墩卸載時逐步記錄各支點反力與梁體高程，確認與施工階段分析一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closure, pylons and stays in place: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「河谷中央合龍段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mid-valley closure joint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在溫度快速變化時強行焊接合龍，焊道冷卻中受拉而開裂或產生鎖入應力；臨時墩卸載順序錯誤則讓相鄰斜索或支承瞬間超載，梁體出現不預期的扭轉或局部屈曲。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Forcing a closure weld while temperatures change quickly can crack the cooling weld or lock in stresses; unloading temporary towers in the wrong order can momentarily overload neighbouring stays or bearings, causing unexpected twist or local buckling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個體系轉換的順序決定最終梁體應力與線形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The sequence of this system change determines final deck stresses and profile.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the two deck ends are aligned and welded, closure is done and later sequence does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closure, pylons and stays in place" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在溫度快速變化時強行焊接合龍，焊道冷卻中受拉而開裂或產生鎖入應力；臨時墩卸載順序錯誤則讓相鄰斜索或支承瞬間超載，梁體出現不預期的扭轉或局部屈曲。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter.

quiz.explanationEn: Forcing a closure weld while temperatures change quickly can crack the cooling weld or lock in stresses; unloading temporary towers in the wrong order can momentarily overload neighbouring stays or bearings, causing unexpected twist or local buckling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」與「通車前載重試驗與量測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring" and "Pre-opening load test and measurement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斜索振動、阻尼與監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stay vibration, damping and monitoring: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斜索阻尼器與監測索」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stay dampers and instrumented stays” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 長斜索質量輕、本身阻尼很低，在風雨、渦流或橋面振動激勵下容易大幅振動。米約的斜索保護套表面有螺旋肋以抑制風雨振，每根索在橋面上方約 1 公尺處裝設阻尼器，頂推期間還曾以臨時橫向繫索提高頻率與阻尼。公開技術文章也指出，P3 南側有 6 根斜索裝設量測儀器，平均風速超過 15 m/s 或加速度超過 1.5 m/s² 時自動記錄，錨板上另有 12 個聲波感測器偵測斷絲。這些量測把設計假設轉成可追蹤的營運資料。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斜索阻尼器與監測索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long stays are light and have very low inherent damping, so rain–wind, vortex shedding or deck motion can drive large vibrations. Millau's sheaths carry helical ridges against rain–wind vibration, each stay has a damper about 1 m above the deck, and temporary cross-ties raised frequencies and damping during launching. A published paper adds that six stays on the south side of P3 are instrumented, recording automatically when mean wind exceeds 15 m/s or acceleration exceeds 1.5 m/s², and 12 acoustic sensors on anchor plates listen for wire breaks. These measurements turn design assumptions into traceable operating data. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stay dampers and instrumented stays” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：外加阻尼器最佳附加阻尼比約 ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An external damper gives an optimum added damping ratio of about ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斜索阻尼器與監測索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stay dampers and instrumented stays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 長斜索質量輕、本身阻尼很低，在風雨、渦流或橋面振動激勵下容易大幅振動。米約的斜索保護套表面有螺旋肋以抑制風雨振，每根索在橋面上方約 1 公尺處裝設阻尼器，頂推期間還曾以臨時橫向繫索提高頻率與阻尼。

Millau's sheaths carry helical ridges against rain–wind vibration, each stay has a damper about 1 m above the deck, and temporary cross-ties raised frequencies and damping during launching.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring" is correct?
options: 斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。
長斜索質量輕、本身阻尼很低，在風雨、渦流或橋面振動激勵下容易大幅振動。
載重試驗只要量跨中撓度就能證明多跨斜張橋的性能。
optionsEn: Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter.
Long stays are light and have very low inherent damping, so rain–wind, vortex shedding or deck motion can drive large vibrations.
Measuring mid-span deflection alone proves the performance of a multi-span cable-stayed bridge.
quiz.explanation: 長斜索質量輕、本身阻尼很低，在風雨、渦流或橋面振動激勵下容易大幅振動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long stays are light and have very low inherent damping, so rain–wind, vortex shedding or deck motion can drive large vibrations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斜索振動、阻尼與監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stay vibration, damping and monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斜索阻尼器與監測索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stay dampers and instrumented stays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：外加阻尼器最佳附加阻尼比約 ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L。取阻尼器距錨點 x_d = 2.5 m、索長 L = 120 m，ζ ≈ 0.5×2.5/120 ≈ 1.04%。Scruton 數 Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²)，m = 100 kg/m、D = 0.25 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，Sc = 100×0.0104/(1.25×0.0625) ≈ 13.3，高於常用的風雨振門檻 10。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An external damper gives an optimum added damping ratio of about ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L. With x_d = 2.5 m from the anchorage and L = 120 m, ζ ≈ 0.5×2.5/120 ≈ 1.04%. The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) with m = 100 kg/m, D = 0.25 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ is Sc = 100×0.0104/(1.25×0.0625) ≈ 13.3, above the commonly used rain–wind threshold of 10. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝阻尼器前後分別做自由衰減試驗（以繩索拉離後釋放），量測各階模態的阻尼比，與設計目標比較；營運中定期下載監測索的加速度與風速紀錄，確認觸發事件的振幅、頻率與風況，聲波事件則逐一比對位置與時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run free-decay tests (pull with a rope and release) before and after damper installation, measuring modal damping ratios against the target; in service download instrumented-stay accelerations with wind records to examine triggered events by amplitude, frequency and wind condition, and locate and time-stamp every acoustic event.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) with m = 100 kg/m, D = 0.25 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ is Sc = 100×0.0104/(1.25×0.0625) ≈ 13.3, above the commonly used rain–wind threshold of 10. steps.title: 鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel deck fatigue and surfacing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「正交異性橋面焊縫」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orthotropic deck welds” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性鋼橋面直接承受車輪荷載，頂板只有十幾公釐厚（公開資料：12 至 14 mm），輪載在加勁肋與頂板的焊縫、加勁肋穿過橫隔板的開孔處產生局部彎曲應力；每一輛重車通過都是一次應力循環，數十年累積下來就是疲勞問題。鋪面不只是行車表面，它與鋼板共同作用可以分散輪壓、降低焊縫應力幅，同時保護鋼板免於水與除冰鹽。因此鋪面材料、厚度與黏結品質都是疲勞設計的一部分，而不是後期才決定的裝修項目。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「正交異性橋面焊縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An orthotropic steel deck carries wheel loads directly through a top plate only about a dozen millimetres thick (published: 12 to 14 mm), so wheels cause local bending stresses at rib-to-deck welds and at rib cut-outs in the diaphragms; every heavy vehicle is a stress cycle, and decades of them make fatigue the governing issue. Surfacing is not just a running layer: acting with the plate it spreads wheel pressure, lowers weld stress ranges and protects the steel from water and de-icing salt. Surfacing material, thickness and bond quality are therefore part of fatigue design, not a finish chosen later. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Orthotropic deck welds” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「正交異性橋面焊縫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orthotropic deck welds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa、實際應力幅 Δσ = 50 MPa 時，N = 2×10⁶×(71/50)³ ≈ 5.73×10⁶ 次；若鋪面劣化使應力幅升到 60 MPa，N ≈ 3.31×10⁶ 次，壽命約減少 42%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. For detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa and an actual range Δσ = 50 MPa, N = 2×10⁶×(71/50)³ ≈ 5.73×10⁶ cycles; if degraded surfacing raises the range to 60 MPa, N ≈ 3.31×10⁶ cycles, about 42% less life. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以應變計量測重車通過時加勁肋焊縫附近的應力歷時，用雨流計數換算等效應力幅，與設計假設比較；定期以目視、磁粒或相位陣列超音波檢查焊趾與開孔處的裂紋，並檢查鋪面裂縫、剝離與排水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Strain-gauge rib welds under heavy traffic, convert the histories to equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design assumptions; periodically inspect weld toes and cut-outs by visual, magnetic-particle or phased-array ultrasonic testing, and check the surfacing for cracks, debonding and drainage.

steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.title: 鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel deck fatigue and surfacing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「正交異性橋面焊縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orthotropic deck welds” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以應變計量測重車通過時加勁肋焊縫附近的應力歷時，用雨流計數換算等效應力幅，與設計假設比較；定期以目視、磁粒或相位陣列超音波檢查焊趾與開孔處的裂紋，並檢查鋪面裂縫、剝離與排水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Strain-gauge rib welds under heavy traffic, convert the histories to equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design assumptions; periodically inspect weld toes and cut-outs by visual, magnetic-particle or phased-array ultrasonic testing, and check the surfacing for cracks, debonding and drainage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護計畫應把鋪面狀況與焊縫檢查放在同一張表，重車車道與輪跡帶列為優先檢查區；鋪面更換時規定黏結層試驗與厚度允差，避免施工機具在鋼板上造成刻痕。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance plan should track surfacing condition and weld inspection together, prioritising heavy lanes and wheel paths; resurfacing specifications must include bond tests and thickness tolerances and protect the plate from gouging by equipment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：焊趾裂紋若沿頂板厚度方向擴展，最後會在鋪面下貫穿頂板，水分從裂縫進入箱內造成腐蝕；鋪面剝離或車轍讓輪壓更集中，加速裂紋成長，形成惡性循環。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A weld-toe crack growing through the top plate eventually penetrates under the surfacing, letting water into the box and causing corrosion; debonded or rutted surfacing concentrates wheel pressure and speeds crack growth in a vicious circle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steel deck fatigue and surfacing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「正交異性橋面焊縫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orthotropic deck welds” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 焊趾裂紋若沿頂板厚度方向擴展，最後會在鋪面下貫穿頂板，水分從裂縫進入箱內造成腐蝕；鋪面剝離或車轍讓輪壓更集中，加速裂紋成長，形成惡性循環。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A weld-toe crack growing through the top plate eventually penetrates under the surfacing, letting water into the box and causing corrosion; debonded or rutted surfacing concentrates wheel pressure and speeds crack growth in a vicious circle. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此鋪面材料、厚度與黏結品質都是疲勞設計的一部分，而不是後期才決定的裝修項目。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surfacing material, thickness and bond quality are therefore part of fatigue design, not a finish chosen later.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel deck fatigue and surfacing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 焊趾裂紋若沿頂板厚度方向擴展，最後會在鋪面下貫穿頂板，水分從裂縫進入箱內造成腐蝕；鋪面剝離或車轍讓輪壓更集中，加速裂紋成長，形成惡性循環。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement.

steps.title: 支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bearings, joints and concession maintenance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spherical bearings and end joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼梁在各墩頂以支承傳力，公開資料記載使用新型球面支承，墩頂反力在不對稱載重與極端風況下可達約 100 MN，並需考慮上拔。梁的溫度伸縮在兩端橋台由伸縮縫吸收，伸縮量是全橋最大的。米約由 Eiffage 以特許經營方式興建與營運，鋼材供應商資料提到特許期含施工共 78 年；在這麼長的期間內，支承滑動面、伸縮縫、斜索與塗裝都要更換或翻修，因此設計時就必須預留頂升點、更換空間與交通維持方式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The deck bears on each pier head through bearings; published data mention a new type of spherical bearing, pier-head reactions up to about 100 MN under unbalanced loads and extreme wind, and uplift to be considered. Thermal movement is taken by expansion joints at the two abutments, which see the bridge's largest movements. Millau was built and is operated by Eiffage under a concession that the steel supplier reports as 78 years including construction; over such a period, bearing sliding surfaces, joints, stays and coatings must be replaced or refurbished, so jacking points, replacement space and traffic arrangements must be designed in from the start. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spherical bearings and end joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：PTFE 滑動球面支承在低溫時摩擦係數取 μ = 0.03，墩頂反力 N = 100 MN，滑動時傳到墩頂的水平力 F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a PTFE spherical sliding bearing at low temperature take μ = 0.03; with a pier-head reaction N = 100 MN, sliding transfers F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN horizontally to the pier head.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Spherical bearings and end joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 鋼梁在各墩頂以支承傳力，公開資料記載使用新型球面支承，墩頂反力在不對稱載重與極端風況下可達約 100 MN，並需考慮上拔。梁的溫度伸縮在兩端橋台由伸縮縫吸收，伸縮量是全橋最大的。

Thermal movement is taken by expansion joints at the two abutments, which see the bridge's largest movements.

quiz.question: 關於「支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bearings, joints and concession maintenance" is correct?
options: 支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。
鋼梁在各墩頂以支承傳力，公開資料記載使用新型球面支承，墩頂反力在不對稱載重與極端風況下可達約 100 MN，並需考慮上拔。

steps.title: 支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bearings, joints and concession maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spherical bearings and end joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：PTFE 滑動球面支承在低溫時摩擦係數取 μ = 0.03，墩頂反力 N = 100 MN，滑動時傳到墩頂的水平力 F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN。橋台處以中央為不動點、半長 1,230 m、溫差 35 °C，伸縮量 ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,230×35 ≈ 0.52 m。μ 與溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a PTFE spherical sliding bearing at low temperature take μ = 0.03; with a pier-head reaction N = 100 MN, sliding transfers F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN horizontally to the pier head. At an abutment, with the deck fixed at the centre, a half-length of 1,230 m and a 35 °C range give ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,230×35 ≈ 0.52 m. μ and the temperature range are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期量測各支承的滑動位置與傾角、伸縮縫開口與梁溫，繪出位移—溫度關係判斷是否卡滯；支承更換前以頂升試驗確認反力與千斤頂位置，伸縮縫檢查齒板、防水帶與錨栓。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Regularly measure bearing displacements and rotations, joint openings and deck temperature, plotting movement against temperature to detect seizure; before replacing a bearing confirm the reaction and jack positions by a trial lift, and inspect joint fingers, seals and anchors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: PTFE 滑動球面支承在低溫時摩擦係數取 μ = 0.03，墩頂反力 N = 100 MN，滑動時傳到墩頂的水平力 F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN。橋台處以中央為不動點、半長 1,230 m、溫差 35 °C，伸縮量 ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,230×35 ≈ 0.52 m。μ 與溫差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a PTFE spherical sliding bearing at low temperature take μ = 0.03; with a pier-head reaction N = 100 MN, sliding transfers F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN horizontally to the pier head. At an abutment, with the deck fixed at the centre, a half-length of 1,230 m and a 35 °C range give ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,230×35 ≈ 0.52 m. μ and the temperature range are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bearings, joints and concession maintenance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spherical bearings and end joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期量測各支承的滑動位置與傾角、伸縮縫開口與梁溫，繪出位移—溫度關係判斷是否卡滯；支承更換前以頂升試驗確認反力與千斤頂位置，伸縮縫檢查齒板、防水帶與錨栓。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Regularly measure bearing displacements and rotations, joint openings and deck temperature, plotting movement against temperature to detect seizure; before replacing a bearing confirm the reaction and jack positions by a trial lift, and inspect joint fingers, seals and anchors. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：特許營運的維護手冊應列出可更換構件清單、頂升點與容許頂升量、更換時的交通配置與天候限制；每次更換後更新竣工資料與監測基準，並在特許期末交接時提供完整的構件履歷。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The concession maintenance manual should list replaceable components, jacking points and permitted lifts, traffic layouts and weather limits for replacement; after each replacement update as-built records and monitoring baselines, and hand over complete component histories at the end of the concession.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承滑動面磨耗或被異物卡住時，溫度力無法釋放，墩頂水平力遠超設計值，薄肢橋墩可能開裂；伸縮縫錨固鬆脫則在重車衝擊下逐步破壞並讓水進入箱梁端部。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A worn or obstructed sliding surface stops thermal relief, so horizontal force at the pier head far exceeds design and the slender shafts may crack; loose joint anchorage fails progressively under heavy-vehicle impact and lets water into the box ends. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bearings, joints and concession maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spherical bearings and end joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承滑動面磨耗或被異物卡住時，溫度力無法釋放，墩頂水平力遠超設計值，薄肢橋墩可能開裂；伸縮縫錨固鬆脫則在重車衝擊下逐步破壞並讓水進入箱梁端部。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A worn or obstructed sliding surface stops thermal relief, so horizontal force at the pier head far exceeds design and the slender shafts may crack; loose joint anchorage fails progressively under heavy-vehicle impact and lets water into the box ends. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：米約由 Eiffage 以特許經營方式興建與營運，鋼材供應商資料提到特許期含施工共 78 年；在這麼長的期間內，支承滑動面、伸縮縫、斜索與塗裝都要更換或翻修，因此設計時就必須預留頂升點、更換空間與交通維持方式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Millau was built and is operated by Eiffage under a concession that the steel supplier reports as 78 years including construction; over such a period, bearing sliding surfaces, joints, stays and coatings must be replaced or refurbished, so jacking points, replacement space and traffic arrangements must be designed in from the start.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bearings, joints and concession maintenance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
